goal: Gate multi-dataset EEG-to-fMRI experiments so timing, task structure, artifact status, and target coverage are handled per dataset.

common_rules.target_space: Use Schaefer100 as a common auxiliary readout/evaluation target. Do not treat it as the only teacher latent once MNI-volume/NeuroSTORM latents are available.
common_rules.timing: Preserve sample_time and target_sample_time in every feature cache. Report lag in steps and actual seconds.
common_rules.roi_mask: Use ROI mask loss or exclude runs with incomplete atlas coverage from unmasked shared-target training.
common_rules.eeg_channels: Keep EEG channels only for model input; use ECG/EOG/CWL/stimulus/response channels for QC or artifact regression, not as EEG tokens.
